_comment: R2 lifecycle for the product bucket's Wave 0 caches (track 0A; ROADMAP §8: 90 days since last use).
Readers refresh an object older than 30 days when they use it (sidecars._download, clip_store._refresh),
so an age rule of 90 days IS 'last use + 90 days'. Not applied by any workflow: an operator adds these
rules once with `npx wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add <bucket> <id> <prefix> --expire-days 90`
(never `lifecycle set`, which REPLACES every existing rule on the bucket).
Shape: the `rules` array wrangler's `r2 bucket lifecycle set --file` accepts.
